name: Spirits of Limbo
source:
There are precious few pleasures for those living in Limbo. Sampling the otherworldly flavors served in Spirits of Limbo, the only establishment of its kind in the realm, is one of them. Lial, the bartender, is only too happy to cater to that demand. However, the arrival of a new customer shrouded in mystery disrupts their routine of mixing drinks and befriending clientele..

[From [url=https://orcamartiangames.itch.io/spirits-of-limbo]Itch.io[/url]]
